notes.title: Application Update Again
notes.notes:
This update fixed the issue of increasing memory usage over time when running, and fixed the issue of automatically reading program errors after automatic saving after the last update.  If the program fails to launch quickly on Steam, please run DiuTaMaPro directly in the local file, this issue will need to wait for the Steam team to help.

本次更新，修复了运行时会随时间增加内存占用的问题，修复了上次更新后自动保存后自动读取程序报错的问题。如遇到程序在Steam上的快捷启动失败，请直接在本地文件中运行DiuTaMaPro，此问题还需等待Steam团队协助。
